name: retro_pulp
description: A 1970s screen-print road-trip cast on a desert highway at sunset. The boss runs the garage, the worker turns the wrenches, the analyst keeps the books in the diner.
style: retro 1970s road-trip screen-print poster, bold black ink outlines of even weight, halftone dot shading, grainy textured flat colour, duotone-leaning sunset palette of burnt orange, dusty purple, warm cream and deep brown, vintage pulp comic poster look, no gradients

background.prompt: An endless desert highway at sunset seen straight on, printed like a vintage poster. Low horizon two thirds down the frame. Upper third: a huge low cream sun touching the horizon at the extreme left edge, a dusty purple mountain range running along the horizon behind it, a grainy orange-to-purple sky. Lower third: burnt-orange desert floor with scrub bushes only at the extreme left and right edges, the two-lane asphalt road running straight down the middle and vanishing at the horizon with a single dashed centre line. Wide open empty middle with nothing on the road.

boss.role: owns the garage and the forecourt - watches every dollar at the pump
boss.look: a broad-shouldered garage owner in an open brown leather jacket over a cream shirt, a flat cap, dark trousers with a heavy belt, weathered confident face

worker.role: turns the wrenches - grease under the nails, paid by the job
worker.look: a young mechanic in stained brown overalls with one strap undone, a white singlet underneath, a backwards cap, heavy boots, a red shop rag hanging from the back pocket

analyst.role: keeps the books in the diner and explains the numbers
analyst.look: a woman with a rolled brown hairdo and round sunglasses pushed up on her head, a cream blouse with short sleeves, a mustard vest, a high-waisted brown skirt, a pencil tucked behind one ear

_panel_color_note: Warm cream, the colour of a printed paper slab, so a panel reads as a diner interior pasted over the sunset plate instead of a hole in the desert.
